commonControls.pairedUnit: independent mission or longitudinal lineage; seeds nested within unit
commonControls.assignment: randomized arm order with isolated stores and workspaces
commonControls.holdout: tasks, families and oracle implementations excluded from training and policy selection
commonControls.failures: retain every assigned attempt, timeout, refusal, retry and intervention
commonControls.analysis: paired cluster bootstrap by independent unit; simultaneous 98.333333% intervals for three primary hypotheses
commonControls.stopping: seal corpus, sample size, seeds, thresholds and analysis before first outcome; no optional stopping
commonControls.conclusion: support only if the interval lower bound exceeds the practical gain and every validity condition holds
commonControls.powerAnalysis: required on disjoint pilot data before preregistration
commonControls.missingEvidence: inconclusive; never zero cost, success or absence of intervention

hypotheses.control: same runtime with only allostatic corrections disabled; hard safety and budget gates remain enabled
hypotheses.additionalControl: static conservative fanout tuned on training only
stressors: memory pressure inside an isolated runner
hypotheses.primary: fraction of missions reaching independently verified useful completion within the shared budget and deadline without invariant violation
secondary: time to unrecoverable operational failure with censoring reported
validity: no credit for indefinite suspension or abandoning required work
gain over ablation and static conservative control

hypotheses.control: same runtime with topology frozen after selection on training only
hypotheses.additionalControl: sham or unsuitable transition; include unchanged-environment negative control
hypotheses.primary: fraction of missions meeting the new independent acceptance oracle after an external unannounced environment change within the shared total budget
validity: change injected externally after a recorded execution boundary
future change absent from all prompts and policy inputs before injection
signed applied transition and worker binding observed
success evaluated independently of transition admission

hypotheses.treatment: autonomous persistent developmental loop with governed learning enabled
hypotheses.control: same autonomous loop and budget with developmental memory and policy frozen
hypotheses.additionalControl: developmental state reset between episodes; identical initial backlog and scheduler
hypotheses.primary: lineage-level held-out verified success-rate gain versus frozen control, retained in every late evaluation window after restart and withdrawal of learning feedback
hypotheses.horizon: at least seven real days AND 100 missions per lineage; accelerated fixtures do not meet this requirement
validity: multiple independent lineages; task episodes are not independent replicates
fixed late windows declared before execution
zero human task-specific hints, patches or unplanned restarts after setup
count emergency operator actions as interventions
no forgetting beyond a preregistered noninferiority margin
environment and model held fixed across learning comparisons
